newsitem.title: USA: Plymouth Rubber Co Inc Q3 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Plymouth Rubber Co Inc Q3 net rises.

text.p: Third Quarter Ended Nine Months Ended

(a) Earnings per share figures have been adjusted to account for a 5 percent stock dividend on both Class A and Class B common stock declared on June 11, 1996, and paid in Class B common shares on August 19, 1996, to shareholders of record as of June 24, 1996.

(b) Net income for fiscal 1996's third quarter reflects the recapture of $1,531,000 of Deferred Tax Valuation Allowance, a $627,000 increase in Net Deferred Tax Assets and a $1,571,000 before tax charge for the amortization of the intangible asset (Unrecognized Net Obligation at Transition).

(c) Net income for fiscal 1996's first nine months reflects the recapture of $1,706,000 of Deferred Tax Valuation Allowance, a $147,000 before tax gain from litigation, a $627,000 increase in Net Deferred Tax Assets and a $1,571,000 before tax charge for the amortization of the intangible asset (Unrecognized Net Obligation at Transition).

(d) Net income for fiscal 1995's third quarter reflects both the recapture of $136,000 of Deferred Tax Valuation Allowance (resulting in an effective tax rate of 5 percent), and $175,000 before tax gain, net of increased reserves, from an insurance settlement.

(e) Net income for fiscal 1995's first nine months reflects the recapture of $612,000 of Deferred Tax Valuation Allowance (resulting in an effective tax rate of 9 percent), a $395,000 before tax gain from litigation, and $175,000 before tax gain, net of increased reserves, from an insurance settlement.
